title: 1.2 Parent Functions and Transformations

icans: I can identify the family of a function.
I can describe translations, reflections, stretches, and shrinks.
I can describe combinations of transformations and find the domain and range.

vocab: the ___________ function in a family (constant, linear, absolute value, quadratic, …)
changes the size, shape, position, or ______________ of a graph
__________ a graph left, right, up, or down
_____________ every y-value by a > 1 / by 0 < a < 1

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

blocks.stem:
Identify the function family of each function.
a.  f(x) = |x − 1|        b.  g(x) = −3x² + 5        c.  h(x) = 2x − 7        d.  k(x) = 6

notes: Translations: f(x) + k moves the graph _______________; f(x − h) moves it _______________.

blocks.stem: Describe the transformation of f(x) = x² represented by g(x) = (x + 3)². Then graph both.

notes: Reflections: −f(x) is a reflection in the _______________; f(−x) is a reflection in the _______________.
Stretches and shrinks: a · f(x) with a > 1 is a vertical _______________; with 0 < a < 1 it is a vertical _______________.

blocks.stem: Describe the transformation of f(x) = |x| represented by g(x) = −2|x − 1| + 3.
Describe the transformation of f(x) = x² represented by g(x) = ½x².

tickets.stem: What is the function family of f(x) = 5x − 1?
Describe the transformation of f(x) = x² represented by g(x) = x² − 6.
